title: CardTemplate
description: Schema for card design variant templates used in layout-anchored redaction (§5.1) and dataset generation (§10.1).

id.description: Unique identifier for this template variant (e.g. philsys-card, lto-dl-current).

name.description: Human-readable name of the card variant.

document_class.description: Document class according to SECURE_GALLERY.md §8.1 (canonical values only: philsys, lto, payment_card).

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio of the card (width / height) in physical units (e.g. ~1.5858 for standard ID-1).

description.description: Description of the card design variant, issuing authority, and design period.

card_dimensions_mm.description: Physical card dimensions in millimeters if known.

fields.description: List of field definitions with normalized polygon boundaries.

type.description: Field type from the SECURE_GALLERY.md §8.1 field list.

polygon.description: Normalized coordinates [x, y] in [0, 1] relative to the card dimensions (top-left is [0, 0]).

items.description: A 2D point [x, y] where 0 <= x <= 1 and 0 <= y <= 1.

sensitive.description: Whether this field is sensitive and must be redacted (yes/true) or left visible (no/false) per §8.1.

description.description: Optional notes or details about the field.
